blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Public prosecutor and Akbayan Rep. Chel Diokno has asked the Senate impeachment court whether it will be the vacant seats of absent senator-judges who will decide on Vice President Sara Duterte’s impeachment case should the threshold needed for a conviction remain. In his speech on Wednesday, during oral arguments on how many votes are needed to convict an impeached official, Diokno stressed that the 1987 Constitution requires senator-judges to take an oath because they are exercising an “extraordinary constitutional function” separate from their legislative duties.
